Watch register usage and shared-memory usage because both can limit active warps per SM. Avoid register spilling, since spilled registers go to local memory backed by global memory.Useful tools and controls include `cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize`, Nsight Compute occupancy metrics, and `__launch_bounds__`.**Most impactful when:** the kernel has latency to hide, especially memory latency, and occupancy is limited by excessive registers, shared memory, or poor block sizing.---### 4. Reduce warp divergenceKeep threads in a warp on the same control-flow path. Replace short divergent branches with predicated or branchless expressions where appropriate.
